'''Takahashi Shrine''' (たかはしじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Matsumoto, {{ill|Mishima, Shizuoka|Q653478|qid=Q653478}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4402010 高橋神社] - 静岡県神社庁</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined in the southwestern part of Mishima City, northwest of the Matsumoto district, on the east bank of the Sakaigawa River, adjacent on the north to {{ill|Kuwado Shrine|ja|鍬戸神社|qid=Q134928574}} in the Nagabuse district.

Its founding is unknown, but it is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Takahashi Shrine''' (たかはしじんじゃ), and it is an old shrine also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Takahashi no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/takahasi_title.htm 高橋神社] - 玄松子</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140205-01.html 高橋神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref>.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was listed as a village shrine<ref name="engi"/>.
